meta.name: Pushpaka Vimanam
meta.description: Pushpak finds a way to travel through time. He makes one change in the past, which puts everything in his present at risk.

videos.title: The Man Who Knew
videos.overview: A mysterious guy wins an impossible cricket bet before disappearing into the night. Pushpak, an underestimated insurance agent, is haunted by a love he cannot let go of.

videos.title: The Warning
videos.overview: When a library becomes the target of land grab, Pushpak protects its owner. Strange vibrations at the temple and a mysterious book hint at a disaster approaching Darwin Colony.

videos.title: Before We Broke Up
videos.overview: When Savitri refuses to forgive Pushpak, he revisits the college romance that once made them inseparable and recalls the misunderstanding that destroyed their relationship.

videos.title: The Impossible Lift
videos.overview: As Pushpak's struggles collide with the growing mystery around the colony, the unfinished construction building begins to take on a significance that could change his life forever.

videos.title: Welcome to This World
videos.overview: Savitri is smiling at him again, and a beloved restaurant owner is alive. But Stranger is already waiting for him in 2016.

videos.title: Two Pushpaks
videos.overview: He knows what happens tomorrow, and he is determined to stop it. But his younger self is walking beside Savitri, and the two Pushpaks keep missing each other by minutes.

videos.title: Beat the Future
videos.overview: A betting den, a debt and a perfect run of predictions. Pushpak uses tomorrow's knowledge today, while in a college hostel, someone is quietly planning a very different tomorrow.

videos.title: Locked In!
videos.overview: Trapped in a room full of secrets, Pushpak gets one chance to witness what really happened that day. What he sees rewrites eight years of belief!

videos.title: The Reluctant Hero
videos.overview: The drones are coming to Darwin Colony, and Savitri begins to suspect her boss. Pushpak, who knows exactly what Kiran did, ends up standing in front of his camera.

videos.title: Only Pushpak
videos.overview: The stranger tells Savitri that only Pushpak can save the colony, making her furious. Pushpak stops the drones. The stranger admits he sent Pushpak back, and Savitri is in danger.

videos.title: The Confession
videos.overview: Pushpak pulls a wounded Savitri out of danger, and she wishes he hadn't. He takes her to Kiran, who finally confesses. But the truth has a price.

videos.title: The Upload
videos.overview: Pushpak knows exactly when the video will leak. Guruji exposes who is behind the colony scam, while in college, Kiran's phone goes missing and a fake account goes live.
